entity_id.title: EntityId
entity_id.description: Entity ID that was assigned during the 'CREATE' action under POST endpoint. Mandatory input for PATCH endpoint

beneficial_owner.title: BeneficialOwner
beneficial_owner.description:
Parameters are applicable for both 'POST' and 'PATCH' endpoints.

Up to 4 beneficial owner information can be given.
Maintain the beneficial owner details order as per their ownership with the entity.

- Not applicable for sole trader (`entity.type`='S')

date_of_birth.title: date_of_birth
date_of_birth.description:
Mandatory parameter under 'Beneficial Owner' object if the object is used.
Populates the date of birth date pertaining to the Beneficial owner of the entity. It is in fixed 10 digit format(YYYY-MM-DD) as per ISO format.

- Non-Modifiable parameter under 'PATCH' endpoint.

first_name.title: first_name
first_name.description:
First name of Beneficial Owner linked to the merchant.

- Modifiable parameter under 'PATCH' endpoint.

last_name.title: last_name
last_name.description:
Last name of Beneficial Owner linked to the merchant.

- Modifiable parameter under 'PATCH' endpoint.

first_name.title: first_name
first_name.description:
First name of entity linked to the merchant.
Further `entity.type` level applicability is mentioned below,

- Conditionally mandatory for Sole Trader (`entity.type`='S')
- Not applicable for Company (`entity.type`='C').

- Modifiable parameter under 'PATCH' endpoint.

last_name.title: last_name
last_name.description:
Last name of entity linked to the merchant.

- For Sole Trader (`entity.type`='S') - include the last name
- For Company (`entity.type`='C') - include the Legal Entity Name.

- Modifiable parameter under 'PATCH' endpoint.

Entity.title: Entity
Entity.description: Mandatory object for both 'CREATE' (POST) and 'UPDATE' (PATCH) action values.

type.title: type
type.description:
Mandatory parameter for POST endpoint.
Populate the entity type applicable for the entity / merchant.

C = COMPANY

S = SOLE TRADER - enterprise owned and run by one person and in which there is no legal distinction between the owner and the business entity.

- Non-Modifiable parameter under 'PATCH' endpoint.

date_of_birth.title: date_of_birth
date_of_birth.description:
Mandatory parameter for POST endpoint.
Populates the date of birth or incorporation date pertaining to the entity that is being activated under this Entity. It is in fixed 10 digit format(YYYY-MM-DD) as per ISO format.

- Non-Modifiable parameter under 'PATCH' endpoint.

website.title: website
website.description:
Populate the website of entity.

- Modifiable parameter under 'PATCH' endpoint.

store_name.title: store_name
store_name.description:
Populate the store name of entity.

- Modifiable parameter under 'PATCH' endpoint.

business_purpose.title: business_purpose
business_purpose.description:
Populate the business purpose applicable.

- Modifiable parameter under 'PATCH' endpoint.

acronym.title: acronym
acronym.description:
Populate the acronym for the Entity.

- Modifiable parameter under 'PATCH' endpoint.

country_of_operation.title: country_of_operation
country_of_operation.description:
Enter the 'Country code' on which the entity is operated.

- Non-Modifiable parameter under 'PATCH' endpoint.
